description: Restyle a character's neutral sheet with a style kit, for this project only. The neutral sheet stays unchanged. The result is NOT used by any run until lab_stilblatt_freigeben. Generating again removes an existing approval, and a different kit starts the sheet over. Costs credits per view: call with get_cost first, name the price and wait for the person's yes. Views without an image are refunded and named in `fehlgeschlagen` and `nicht_gespiegelt`.

character_id.description: Character id from lab_list_characters, positive integer as string

get_cost.description: Return the price only. Nothing is generated or charged.

project_id.description: Project id, positive integer as string

views.description: Views to restyle. Omit for every standard view the neutral sheet has.

name: lab_stilblatt_erzeugen
title: Generate Style Sheet
